'''Kamitsukeno no Michichi''' (上毛野 三千) was a [[:en:Japanese nobility|nobleman]] during the {{ill|Asuka period|en|Asuka period|qid=Q210688|lt=Asuka period}} of Japan. His {{ill|Kabane|en|Kabane|qid=Q1664099|lt=Kabane}} title was {{ill|Kimi (kabane)|ja|キミ}}. He held the Rank of {{ill|Dai Kinge|ja|大錦下|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkinoshita|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11439798}}.

== Biography ==  
The {{ill|Kamitsukeno clan|ja|上毛野氏}}, to which Michichi belonged, is noted in the {{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|en|Shinsen Shōjiroku|qid=Q1045362|lt=Shinsen Shōjiroku}} under the Left and Right Imperial Descendants sections, identifying them as descendants of Emperor {{ill|Emperor Sujin|en|Emperor Sujin|qid=Q333530|lt=Sujin}}'s eldest son, {{ill|Prince Toyokiirihiko|ja|豊城入彦命|2=ja|3=豊城入彦命|qid=Q11633375|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Toyokiiribiko no Mikoto|13=User:Immanuelle/Prince Toyokiirihiko}}.<ref>''Nihon Shoki,'' Emperor Sujin, 48th Year, 1st Month, 10th Day.</ref>

According to Volume 29 of the ''Nihon Shoki,'' in the 10th year of Emperor Tenmu's reign (681), a decree was issued from the {{ill|Ōandom|ja|大極殿}} (Great Hall) ordering the compilation of the {{ill|Teiki|en|Teiki|qid=Q1107261|lt=Teiki}} (Imperial Genealogies) and records of ancient matters. Michichi's name appears seventh among those assigned to this task, following Prince {{ill|Kawashima|ja|川島皇子}} and Prince {{ill|Prince Osakabe|en|Prince Osakabe|qid=Q3403344|lt=Osakabe}}, and he was the first commoner listed.<ref>''Nihon Shoki,'' Emperor Tenmu, 10th Year, 3rd Month, 17th Day.</ref> At that time, he held the Rank of {{ill|Dai Kinge|ja|大錦下|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōkinoshita|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11439798}}.

This endeavor, however, was never completed. Later that same year, in the 8th month, Michichi passed away.<ref>''Nihon Shoki,'' Emperor Tenmu, 10th Year, 8th Month, 11th Day.</ref>

In the 13th year of Emperor Tenmu’s reign (684), the {{ill|Yatsurano Kabane|ja|八色の姓}} reform conferred the kabane title of {{ill|Ason|en|Ason|qid=Q4807592|lt=Ason (kabane)}} on the Kamitsukeno clan, acknowledging the contributions of Michichi and others in their service to the court.<ref>''Nihon Shoki,'' Emperor Tenmu, 13th Year, 11th Month, 1st Day.</ref>
